response.sql: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) as spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(amount) > 0), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT er.link_to_event as event_id, er.spend_ratio, er.spend_ratio / ar.avg_spend_ratio as relative_ratio FROM event_ratios er CROSS JOIN average_ratio ar ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
